record.paper_title: Chen–Ricci Inequality for CR-Warped Products and Related Open Problems
record.original_question: Classify all warped-product CR-submanifolds that attain equality in the Chen–Ricci inequalities proved in Theorem 4.1; in particular, classify those for which the equality cases characterized there—such as the mixed totally geodesic and distribution-wise totally geodesic or umbilical cases—occur.

evidence.quote: Problem 4. Can we classify warped product CR-submanifolds satisfying the equality cases of inequalities in Theorem 4.1 ?

For the equality cases, we have (a) the equality case of (4.1) or (4.2) holds identically for all unit tangent vectors tangent to NT at each x ∈ Mn if and only if Mn is mixed totally geodesic and DT -totally geodesic CR-warped product submanifold in M˜ m(c), (b) the equality case of (4.1) or (4.2) holds identically for all unit tangent vectors tangent to N⊥ at each x ∈ Mn if and only if Mn is mixed totally geodesic and either a D⊥-totally geodesic warped product CR-submanifold, or Mn is a D⊥-totally umbilical CR-warped product in M˜ m(c) with dim N⊥ = 2
On a Kaehler manifold M˜ 2m, the warped product NT ×f N⊥ is called a CR-warped product, if the submanifolds NT and N⊥ are integral manifolds of DT and D⊥, respectively.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\widetilde{M}^{2m}(c)$ be a complex space form of complex dimension $m$ and constant holomorphic sectional curvature $c$, equipped with its Kähler structure $(J,\widetilde g)$. A CR-submanifold $M^n$ of $\widetilde{M}^{2m}(c)$ is a real submanifold endowed with two orthogonal complementary distributions $\mathcal{D}^T$ and $\mathcal{D}^\perp$ on $M^n$ such that $J\mathcal{D}^T=\mathcal{D}^T$ (the holomorphic distribution) and $J\mathcal{D}^\perp\subset T^\perp M^n$ (the totally real distribution). 

Given Riemannian manifolds $(N_T,g_T)$ and $(N_\perp,g_\perp)$ and a positive smooth function $f$ on $N_T$, the warped product $N_T\times_f N_\perp$ is the manifold $N_T\times N_\perp$ with metric $g=g_T\oplus f^2 g_\perp$. The warped product $M^n=N_T\times_f N_\perp$ isometrically immersed in $\widetilde{M}^{2m}(c)$ is called a CR-warped product if $N_T$ and $N_\perp$ are integral manifolds of $\mathcal{D}^T$ and $\mathcal{D}^\perp$, respectively, with $N_T$ a holomorphic submanifold and $N_\perp$ a totally real submanifold of $\widetilde{M}^{2m}(c)$.

Let $h$ denote the second fundamental form of $M^n$ in $\widetilde{M}^{2m}(c)$, $H$ the mean curvature vector, and $\mathrm{Ric}$ the Ricci tensor of $M^n$. Set $n_1=\dim N_T$ and $n_2=\dim N_\perp$. The Chen–Ricci inequality for a CR-warped product asserts that for every unit tangent vector $X\in T_xM^n$,
$$\mathrm{Ric}(X)\;\le\;\tfrac14 n^2\|H\|^2+\Phi(c,n_1,n_2,f,X),\qquad (\star)$$
where $\Phi$ is the explicit curvature/warping term arising from the Gauss equation in $\widetilde{M}^{2m}(c)$ (depending on whether $X\in\mathcal{D}^T$ or $X\in\mathcal{D}^\perp$).

The submanifold $M^n$ is called mixed totally geodesic if $h(X,Z)=0$ for every $X\in\mathcal{D}^T$ and $Z\in\mathcal{D}^\perp$; it is $\mathcal{D}^T$-totally geodesic (resp. $\mathcal{D}^\perp$-totally geodesic) if $h$ vanishes on $\mathcal{D}^T\times\mathcal{D}^T$ (resp. on $\mathcal{D}^\perp\times\mathcal{D}^\perp$); and it is $\mathcal{D}^\perp$-totally umbilical if $h(Z,W)=g(Z,W)\,\xi$ for all $Z,W\in\mathcal{D}^\perp$ and some normal vector field $\xi$.

It is known that:
(a) equality in $(\star)$ holds for every unit $X\in\mathcal{D}^T$ at every $x\in M^n$ iff $M^n$ is mixed totally geodesic and $\mathcal{D}^T$-totally geodesic;
(b) equality in $(\star)$ holds for every unit $X\in\mathcal{D}^\perp$ at every $x\in M^n$ iff $M^n$ is mixed totally geodesic and either $\mathcal{D}^\perp$-totally geodesic, or $\mathcal{D}^\perp$-totally umbilical with $\dim N_\perp=2$.

Problem. Classify, up to isometric congruence in $\widetilde{M}^{2m}(c)$, all CR-warped product submanifolds $N_T\times_f N_\perp$ that satisfy the equality cases (a) and/or (b) above. In particular, give an explicit description of those CR-warped products which are simultaneously mixed totally geodesic and $\mathcal{D}^T$-totally geodesic, and of those which are mixed totally geodesic and either $\mathcal{D}^\perp$-totally geodesic or $\mathcal{D}^\perp$-totally umbilical with $\dim N_\perp=2$.

artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an explicit open problem in the work establishing the Chen–Ricci inequality for CR-warped products in complex space forms. Web searches return related inequalities and partial results (e.g., Ricci soliton classifications and analogous Sasakian/Kenmotsu extensions) but no full classification of CR-warped products attaining equality. No subsequent paper claiming a complete classification was found.

status_evidence.snippet: Lists explicit open problems regarding classification of equality cases.

status_evidence.title: Ricci Soliton of CR-Warped Product Manifolds and Their Classifications
status_evidence.snippet: Recent classifications under Ricci soliton conditions, but not the Chen–Ricci equality classification.
status_evidence.claim: Related classifications exist but do not resolve the equality-case problem.
